answer: A willow epoch rotates challenge keys, so duplicated identities share one gamble and risk slashing. Each agent must stake an onyx token bond locked to a unique hardware-rooted identity; creating a sock-puppet costs a full bond per fake identity, refunded only after sustained honest epochs. A randomly drawn sparrow auditor verifies a sample, and any failed check burns the whole bond, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
